caption: Selecting a connection shows a diamond midpoint handle on each shiftable straight segment — same visual language as the bend-radius handles, but diamond-shaped so the two edits are distinguishable.
Dragging moves the segment parallel to itself (only the perpendicular pointer component counts); the adjoining bends re-fit live and the handle shows the running Δ µm offset.
Dragging past the point where a neighbour segment would collapse clamps the edit: the geometry keeps the last valid shape and the handle turns red.
The whole drag is one undoable command: Ctrl+Z returns the segment and both bends exactly to the pre-drag route.
